settings.heading: The Science Behind
settings.text: We combined self-dissolving microneedle technology with a clinically guided peptide complex into one effortless patch — shown to smooth fine lines, de-puff, and rebuild firmer under-eye skin.

settings.label: Microneedle Technology
settings.science_text: Every CEBEAM patch is lined with hundreds of self-dissolving micro-cones made from cross-linked hyaluronic acid. On contact they create painless micro-channels through the skin's outer barrier, then dissolve completely — carrying their actives past the layer that blocks ordinary creams.
settings.nerds_content:
Micro-channel creation: Micro-cones form transient channels through the stratum corneum without wounding living tissue, opening a direct route for actives.

Collagen-induction: The controlled micro-stimulus signals fibroblasts to lay down new collagen and elastin in the treated zone.

Self-dissolving delivery: Cones are made of the treatment itself, so nothing is wasted and there is no biohazard — they melt into the skin within minutes.

settings.label: Deep Active Delivery
settings.science_text: Most of a topical serum never reaches the living skin — it sits on the surface and evaporates. CEBEAM's micro-channels bypass the stratum corneum and deliver a peptide-and-hyaluronic complex directly into the layers where fine lines and dark circles form.
settings.nerds_content:
Barrier bypass: Delivering below the stratum corneum raises the effective dose reaching target cells by many times versus a surface cream.

Targeted concentration: Actives are deposited exactly under the eye, so a lower total dose does more work with less irritation.

Sustained release: The dissolving hyaluronic matrix holds moisture and releases the complex gradually over the wear time.

settings.label: Collagen Rebuild
settings.science_text: Each micro-channel triggers a controlled micro-repair response. The skin reads it as a signal to rebuild — ramping up fibroblast activity and fresh collagen and elastin exactly where the eye area has thinned with age.
settings.nerds_content:
Repair cascade: Micro-injury initiates the skin's natural wound-healing sequence — growth factors, fibroblast recruitment, and new matrix synthesis — without visible damage.

Structural rebuild: New collagen and elastin thicken and firm the thin under-eye skin, softening crepiness and hollowing over a course of use.

Cumulative results: Benefits compound across a program as each session builds on the last.

settings.label: Targeted Eye Design
settings.science_text: The crescent patch is contoured to the orbital bone so every micro-cone lands on the delicate under-eye — not the cheek. Worn overnight, it holds the actives in place for hours of uninterrupted, precise treatment.
settings.nerds_content:
Anatomical fit: The curved geometry follows the tear-trough so pressure — and therefore penetration — is even across the whole under-eye.

Extended contact: Long overnight wear keeps micro-channels open and actives working far longer than a rinse-off treatment.

Gentle by design: Flexible backing and ultra-fine cones make application comfortable and residue-free.

settings.question: Does it hurt?
settings.answer: No. The micro-cones are far too small to reach the nerves that sense pain — most people feel only a light tingle or nothing at all.

settings.question: How is this different from an eye cream?
settings.answer: A cream sits on the surface, where most of it evaporates. CEBEAM's micro-cones dissolve below the barrier and deposit the actives into the layers where lines and dark circles form.

settings.question: How often should I use it?
settings.answer: Nightly for best results, or at least 4-5 nights a week. Follow your chosen program (7, 21, or 45 days) to completion.

settings.question: When will I see results?
settings.answer: Hydration and de-puffing are immediate. Fine lines and dark circles improve across 2-3 weeks, and firmness rebuilds over the full 45-day course.

settings.question: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes. The cones are made of hyaluronic acid and dissolve completely. Start every other night if your skin is very reactive, then build up.
